title: A Multi-level Bias Elimination through a Decoding Approach with Knowledge Augmentation for Robust Constitutional Alignment of Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly benchmarks and evaluates representational and inferential bias across major religious groups (Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, Buddhist, and Jain) as one of its two primary axes of study (religion and caste). It introduces a specific dataset and evaluation suite to quantify religious bias in Large Language Models.
